name: fluid-image-reveal
title: Fluid Image Reveal
description: OGL fluid simulation used as a mask to reveal a second image beneath as you move the cursor.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-blocks/fluid-image-reveal-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-fluid-image-reveal
    base-image="/images/before.jpg"
    reveal-image="/images/after.jpg"
    :dissipation="0.96"
    :pointer-size="0.005"
    :blend-softness="0.22"
    class="w-full h-[500px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-blocks/fluid-image-reveal-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-fluid-image-reveal
  base-image="/images/before.jpg"
  reveal-image="/images/after.jpg"

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-blocks/fluid-image-reveal-element.js"></script>

<motion-fluid-image-reveal
  base-image="/images/before.jpg"
  reveal-image="/images/after.jpg"
  dissipation="0.96"
  pointer-size="0.005"
  blend-softness="0.22"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: base-image
props.description: URL of the base image that is initially visible.

props.name: reveal-image
props.description: URL of the image to reveal through the fluid mask.

props.name: dissipation
props.description: How quickly the fluid density dissipates over time (lower = faster fade).

props.name: pointer-size
props.description: Size of the cursor's influence on the fluid simulation.

props.name: velocity-dissipation
props.description: How quickly fluid velocity dissipates (affects swirl duration).

props.name: pressure-iterations
props.description: Number of pressure solver iterations (higher = more accurate but slower).

props.name: blend-softness
props.description: Softness of the edge between the two images in the blend zone.
